people.name: Reuben

translations.web: Reuben returned to the pit, and saw that Joseph wasn’t in the pit; and he tore his clothes.
translations.bsb: When Reuben returned to the pit and saw that Joseph was not there, he tore his clothes,
translations.kjv: And Reuben returned unto the pit; and, behold, Joseph was not in the pit; and he rent his clothes.
